items.name: Dishoom — Free Chai
items.description: Get a complimentary chai with any main course ordered before 12pm. One of London's most loved restaurants at a great deal.

items.name: Kids Eat Free — Selected Restaurants
items.description: Kids eat free every Sunday at selected London restaurants. Under 12s eat free with every adult main purchased.

items.name: Afternoon Tea for 2 — 20% Off
items.description: Enjoy a classic British afternoon tea for two with 20% off at selected London hotels. Scones, sandwiches and champagne.

items.name: Primark Oxford Street — Sale Now On
items.description: Up to 50% off selected lines at Europe's biggest Primark. Fashion, beauty, homeware and kids clothes at incredible prices.

items.name: SEA LIFE Aquarium — Kids Go Free
items.description: One child goes free with every full-paying adult at SEA LIFE London Aquarium. Book online for best prices.

items.name: Hotel Spa Day — 30% Off
items.description: Luxury spa day at selected London hotels with 30% off. Includes access to pool, steam room, sauna and relaxation areas.

items.name: Student — Free Museum Entry
items.description: All major London museums are free — British Museum, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, V&A, Tate Modern and more. Show your student card.

items.name: Weekend Brunch — 2 for 1
items.description: Two for one brunch at selected East London restaurants every Saturday and Sunday from 10am-3pm. Book via their websites.

items.name: Family & Friends Railcard
items.description: Save 1/3 on rail fares across the UK. Adults save 33% and kids save 60%. Perfect for London day trips with the family.

items.name: City Break Hotel Package
items.description: Book 2+ nights at selected hotels and receive a complimentary breakfast and late checkout — ask when booking directly.

items.name: Student Cinema Discount
items.description: Most major cinema chains offer discounted tickets for students with valid ID, typically £2-3 off standard price.

items.name: London Zoo Family Ticket
items.description: Family tickets (2 adults + 2 kids) save significantly compared to buying individual tickets. Book online for the best price.

items.name: Weekend Spa Package
items.description: Selected hotel spas offer weekend packages including treatments and pool access at discounted rates — book ahead as slots fill fast.

items.name: Same-Day Theatre Tickets
items.description: The TKTS booth in Leicester Square sells discounted same-day tickets for West End shows — genuinely great savings on top shows.
